The 'src/ol/renderer/canvas/ImageLayer.js' file is responsible for rendering image layers, and any issues in rendering could affect how opacity is applied visually. Lastly, 'src/ol/renderer/canvas/Layer.js' provides foundational rendering logic for layers, which may also impact the overall rendering behavior of styles, including opacity settings.
